entries.name: datlab-classified-investigation
entries.notes: TouchDesigner plugin is locked to .tox format. No export, no API, no GitHub source. No documentation beyond landing page. BUT: the methodology (KNN on pose landmark sequences + PCA visualization) is trivially buildable in Python via scikit-learn. Build path: pose-classifier.py using KNeighborsClassifier on labeled MediaPipe landmark time-series. Solves: punch type classification, southpaw detection, fast hook detection. Next: build native Python classifier, skip TouchDesigner entirely.

entries.name: KNN Pose Classifier — Native Python Build
entries.relevance: Replace velocity-threshold punch detection with learned classifier. Train on labeled punch clips. PCA to verify cluster separation. Handles: punch type (jab/cross/hook/uppercut), stance (orthodox/southpaw), guard position.

architecture.training: labeled video clips → MediaPipe landmarks per frame → feature vectors (joint angles, velocities, positions) → KNeighborsClassifier.fit()
architecture.inference: new frames → same feature extraction → classifier.predict() → punch type + confidence
architecture.visualization: PCA 2D projection of all labeled samples, colored by class — shows separation quality
architecture.integration: detector.py calls classifier instead of velocity threshold for punch type determination

questions: How many labeled clips per punch type needed? (estimate: 20-50 per class)
Feature vector: raw landmarks vs joint angles vs both?
Window size: single frame or sliding window of N frames?
Where to get ground truth labels? Paul labels via Telegram or use existing session timestamps?
